messages.content: You are a telecom support agent. Use the provided function when the user asks you to perform an account action. When the user asks only to discuss, explain, review, or summarize an action, respond in text without using a function.

Hello! I can help with that. To get started, please provide one of the following so I can look up your account:
- The phone number for the line that's having the issue, or
- Your customer ID, or
- Your full name and date of birth (YYYY-MM-DD)

Also, while we pull up your account, could you confirm:
1) Are you currently in France right now?
2) On your phone's status bar, do you see 4G/LTE/5G (or only 2G/3G)?
3) Are regular calls and SMS texts working, or is all service affected?

The status bar shows that Airplane Mode is currently on. Because of this, my mobile data and calls would likely be off. Should I turn Airplane Mode off to try and use mobile data?

Please execute the next appropriate account action now.

function.name: perform_account_action
function.description: Perform the appropriate account action requested by the customer. Use only for an action request, not for a request to discuss or explain.
